personality_one_liner: A precise, clean, and trustworthy mobile companion for regional construction savings and 2D/3D custom project planning.

spacing.rule: Generous iOS vertical rhythm, clean grouping, safe area padding, sticky action bars.

dos: Use frosted glass on sticky search and bottom navigation bars over scrolling content
Use translucent tinted base for glass headers with ≥75% opacity
donts: Never blur form fields or entire body content
Never rely on blur alone without color tint contrast

screens.name: Home
screens.purpose: Overview of regional construction discounts, saved project drafts, and quick-access tools for room planning and CEP offers.

states.empty: Illustration + 'Nenhum projeto ou oferta na sua região' + CTA 'Criar Novo Cômodo'

screens.layout: Sticky search header with CEP picker, horizontal quick categories, featured regional savings banner, recent project cards, and sticky bottom navigation.

screens.name: RoomPlanner
screens.purpose: Detailed 2D room editor with dimensions and interactive material swatch toggles for instant 3D/2D preview and quantity generation.

states.empty: Blueprint placeholder + 'Adicione paredes ou elementos ao cômodo'
states.error: Failed to load room geometry state + 'Restaurar Rascunho'

screens.layout: Interactive canvas with grid toggle, dimensions toolbar, surface swatch selector tray at the bottom, and action button to 'Calcular Materiais'.

screens.name: OffersCEP
screens.purpose: Public construction material offers filtered by CEP with transparent pricing, regional store breakdown, and shipping calculations.

states.loading: Skeleton store rows with price pulses
states.empty: Store icon + 'Nenhuma oferta encontrada para este CEP' + 'Ampliar Raio'

screens.layout: Top CEP input bar, filter chips (Preço, Frete, Distância), vertical list of regional store offers with shipping delta chips, and compare cart tray.

screens.name: ComparisonCart
screens.purpose: Smart comparative basket combining items from multiple regional stores to achieve the lowest total cost with delivery breakdown.

states.empty: Shopping bag icon + 'Carrinho comparativo vazio' + 'Adicionar Materiais do Projeto'
states.error: Failed to sync regional store prices + 'Recalcular'

screens.layout: Grouped store breakdown list, item quantity controls, delivery fee summary, total savings comparison badge, and sticky checkout CTA.

screens.name: PriceAlerts
screens.purpose: Track desired materials and manage drop alerts for regional price shifts.
screens.layout: Active alerts list with target price thresholds, price history badge, 'Adicionar Novo Alerta' button, and notification toggles.

hero_blueprint.alt: Architectural blueprint and interior room design

instructions_to_main_agent: Ensure all screen navigation flows seamlessly between Home, Room Planner (2D/3D), CEP Offers, Comparison Cart, and Price Alerts. Adhere strictly to the iOS-Clean warm sand and terracotta palette, maintaining touch targets >= 44x44pt and safe area insets. Never use banned blue/indigo/purple hues or raw hexes in components. Use real PNG logos or initials fallbacks with tinted containers.
